mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, slot_id, package_id, status, report_url, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM appointment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, slot_id, package_id, status, report_url, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM appointment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (user_id, slot_id, package_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotId}, #{packageId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{expectStatus}
UPDATE appointment SET report_url = #{reportUrl}, status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status != 'CANCELED'
UPDATE appointment SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'COMPLETED')
UPDATE appointment SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, a.user_id AS user_id, u.phone AS phone, ap.name AS package_name, s.appoint_date AS appoint_date, s.time_range AS time_range FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_slot s ON a.slot_id = s.id JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id JOIN appointment_package ap ON a.package_id = ap.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.appoint_date = #{date} AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET deleted = 1 WHERE create_time < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.package_id AS package_id, ap.name AS package_name, ap.price AS price, a.slot_id AS slot_id, s.appoint_date AS appoint_date, s.time_range AS time_range, a.status, a.report_url, a.create_time FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_package ap ON a.package_id = ap.id JOIN appointment_slot s ON a.slot_id = s.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND ap.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT a.id, a.user_id AS user_id, u.phone AS phone, ap.name AS package_name, s.appoint_date AS appoint_date, s.time_range AS time_range, a.status, a.report_url, a.create_time FROM appointment a JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id JOIN appointment_package ap ON a.package_id = ap.id JOIN appointment_slot s ON a.slot_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND ap.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND a.status = #{status} AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%') ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
